scope: Read-only independent review of the fire implementation, its model harness and new browser harness. Browser execution and actual Stage 4 pixels are not certified.

executed.countMeaning: Manually accumulated assertion/groups counter; not 149 independent scenarios or pixel observations.

findings: Actual manifests and explicit vehicle variants support both tanker pictures and four ladder pictures; ambiguous boom and potentially water-capable vehicles are protected from inappropriate wrong-answer placement.
Work changes persistent water, flame, ladder, rescued-person and smoke state; supplied water survives into the pump step and results wait for the child.
Round/catalog tokens, detached-button handling, reward-once behavior, real catalog retry and exit/reentry were reviewed and exercised by the model harness.

Core model checks use explicit expected IDs and world transitions instead of simply copying the implementation answer list. Help-glow helper itself consults implementation roles, so it alone is not independent semantic proof.
Legacy startRound, shootWater, handleTouch, finishRound, showEnding and renderEnding sections match the baseline.

New browser harness uses public controls for six viewport sizes, all three incidents, real response-body hashes for five sources, 503 retry, English voice-engine requests with deliberately failed TTS, storage refusal, exit/reentry and legacy 4/9/16 entry.
